description: One hand plays seven notes. The other chooses the octave.

controls.action: Start or stop the camera and sound.
1–5 fingers: Do–Sol. Shaka: La. OK: Si.
Fist: middle. Thumb up: high. Thumb down: low.
Choose Soft, Bell, Pluck, Retro or Piano.

sections.title: Playing
sections.text: Hold a note and change the octave hand to shift its octave. Hold the octave while changing notes. Release the melody hand to repeat a note. Point the octave thumb clearly up or down; other control-hand shapes stop sound.

sections.title: Sound and settings
sections.text: Choose speaker or headphones in Menu. Tone, volume and hand roles save automatically. Preview offers short note auditions.
